name: Brian Mac Cumhail
original_name: ブライアン・マックール
source:
Brian, a gaunt mercenary for the Shimon, spearheads their witch-hunting brigade. Although often draped in morose lethargy, a dangerous spark ignites within him whenever he pursues his prime target: Tsunuga. This shift from passive to predatory is both sudden and intense, revealing the depths of his concealed determination.

[spoiler]He was betrayed by his organization as his colleagues raped his wife, while he was being questioned by the police.[/spoiler]
